prompt:
A sprite sheet of 6 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 2 x 3 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) a way-lamp of the volcanic ash land: a short square pillar of rough black BASALT blocks, on top an open cage of blackened wrought IRON holding a bowl of coals, UNLIT (the coals dark grey, cold); 2) the SAME basalt-and-iron way-lamp LIT: bright orange flames rising from the coals in the iron cage; 3) a low travellers' TENT of the ash land: dusty grey-brown canvas stretched over a ridge pole, the hem weighted with dark stones, a rust-red cloth tied over the entrance, a thin film of grey ash on the roof; 4) a small ground lantern: a squat black iron fire-pot with a pierced lid and a stubby handle, standing on the ground (unlit); 5) a standing signpost: a thick charred-black wooden post with a weathered grey plank board nailed across it (blank board, no letters), a small heap of stones at its foot; 6) the SAME small black iron fire-pot lantern LIT with a small flame inside.
Scale: the way-lamp is about 50 art pixels tall, the tent about 32 art pixels tall, the fire-pot lantern about 12 art pixels tall, the signpost about 24 art pixels tall; each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels. Items 1 and 2 must be identical in size, shape and colours except that 2 is lit; items 4 and 6 likewise.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Exception: in the lit variants the flames may be bright, but no light spills onto anything around them.
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt: Create a single sprite-sheet image, transparent alpha background, with SIX separate pixel-art JRPG prop sprites arranged as 2 columns × 3 rows, in reading order left-right then top-bottom. Generous transparent spacing between sprites; all completely within canvas, no contact, no cropping. Classic 3/4 top-down RPG perspective: see the tops and front faces, upright objects' bases at bottom. Row 1: (1) unlit volcanic ash-land way-lamp: short square pillar assembled from rough black BASALT blocks, topped with open cage of blackened wrought IRON containing a bowl of dark grey COLD coals; (2) precisely same way-lamp identical silhouette/size/material colors except bright orange/yellow FLAMES rising from its coals, without illuminating the iron or anything else. Row 2: (3) low travellers' TENT, dusty grey-brown canvas stretched over a ridge pole, weighted hem of dark stones, rust-red cloth tied over entrance, thin grey ash layer on roof; (4) UNLIT squat black iron ground fire-pot lantern with pierced lid and stubby handle. Row 3: (5) upright signpost, thick charred-black wood post with weathered grey horizontal plank nailed across, board entirely blank, small heap of stones at post foot; (6) precisely same squat fire-pot lantern as prop 4 identical size/shape/color, but a small orange flame visible inside, with no glow or illumination of surrounding parts. Relative heights: way-lamp 50 native art pixels, tent 32, fire-pot 12, signpost 24; uniform large square pixel grid across WHOLE IMAGE, each native pixel roughly 6-8 display pixels. Premium modern hi-bit 2D JRPG HD pixel art, deliberate hand-placed crisp square pixels, flat opaque pixel clusters of 3-10 pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth/soft brushes, no photographic textures, no noise or checkerboard dithering. Hue-shifted 4-6 shade palettes for each material, earthy saturated purple/red shadows and subtly warm yellow highlights. Neutral soft even upper-left overcast lighting; absolutely no cast shadows, ground, light pools, glow, ambient night effect, vignette, text, numbers, labels, borders, or background. All unused pixels fully transparent.
